items.title: Short Windows, Unmodelled Costs, Unknown Cutoffs: A Pre-Registered Evidence Audit of 91 LLM Trading Papers
items.claim: Ninety-eight percent of LLM trading papers fail leakage controls because they do not test after training cutoffs.

items.title: Automating Asset Pricing Research: An Agentic Search for the SDF
items.claim: An agentic system finds a stochastic discount factor with a 3.38 out-of-sample Sharpe ratio.

items.title: Drift-Resilient Explainable Graph Learning for Financial Fraud Detection: Joint Evaluation of Risk Calibration and Explanation Stability
items.claim: A diagnose-then-act policy matches full retraining performance with 91 percent fewer retraining events.

items.title: Candidate Execution-Time Windows and Intraday Market Microstructure: Evidence from High-frequency Volume, Machine Learning, and Trading Tests
items.claim: Prespecified execution windows are associated with statistically significant abnormal intraday trading volume.

items.title: Accounting-grounded Explainable Machine Learning for Financial Statement Misstatement Detection: Temporal Validation Using U.S. Public-Company Filings
items.claim: Leaky evaluation protocols inflate misstatement detection AUC by up to 0.107 and reverse model rankings.

items.title: Decomposable Reward Modeling and Realistic Environment Design for Reinforcement Learning-based Forex Trading
items.claim: Additional reward penalties do not consistently improve reinforcement learning trading performance.
